stem.en: The Gibbs free energy differential is dG = −S dT + V dp. Which Maxwell relation follows from the equality of its mixed second partial derivatives?
stem.et: Gibbsi vaba energia diferentsiaal on dG = −S dT + V dp. Milline Maxwelli seos järeldub selle segatud teist järku osatuletiste võrdsusest?

label.en: (∂T/∂V)_S = −(∂p/∂S)_V — the relation from dU, not from dG
label.et: (∂T/∂V)_S = −(∂p/∂S)_V — seos, mis tuleneb dU-st, mitte dG-st

label.en: (∂S/∂p)_T = −Nk_B/p — true only for an ideal gas, not the general relation
label.et: (∂S/∂p)_T = −Nk_B/p — kehtib ainult ideaalse gaasi korral, mitte üldise seosena
